# Trading Cards

Trading cards: design a custom trading card with your card name, stats and artwork, from a description or a photo in your MegaScenes library. Creatures, heroes, pets and game cards.

## What it does
Give the card name, the stats and the artwork you want, or pick a photo from your MegaScenes library for the art. Claude tells you the price and designs the card.

**How the files are made:** each trading card is generated by an image model. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

The lettering is drawn by the model, so check it in the result.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install trading-cards@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Trading Cards talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/trading-card/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each trading card uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The trading cards show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_trading_card_models` | Models for trading cards with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_trading_card_cost` | Exact price of one trading card before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_trading_card` | Starts one trading card in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_trading_card` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `list_my_images` | Your uploads and images made here, to pick the one to start from. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Make a legendary trading card of a fire dragon with 3000 attack"
- "Turn my latest MegaScenes dog photo into a trading card"
- "Design a fantasy hero card called Storm Knight"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the trading card (the card name, stats and style, and the photo you pick from your library, if any) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
